title: Signed release inventory, version 1
description: Structure only: required and forbidden members, types, enumerations, string patterns, and length and count limits. A document this schema accepts can still be refused by the engine, because the engine's relational and time-based rules cannot be expressed here; the Python validator in public_pilot is authoritative. Not expressed here: the signature and the key's trust for package_id; that every listed file exists with this hash and no other file does, apart from the root release.json; that the snapshot is listed and resolves; that file names are valid UTF-8. Authoritative: public_pilot.bundles, run by `public-pilot verify-bundle`.
$comment: Patterns end in $(?!\n) so that regular-expression engines whose $ also matches before a final newline still require a whole-string match. JSON Schema counts 1.0 as an integer; the engine requires integer literals.
